tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search published Univs.com study programmes by name, country, degree level, teaching language and scholarship availability. Returns tuition, duration, intakes, the programme page URL and whether students can apply through Univs.

tools.name: search_institutes
tools.description: Search published Univs.com universities, colleges and institutes by name or city and country. Returns location, type, programme count, tuition-from, the institute page URL and whether students can apply through Univs.

tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search education agencies and study abroad consultants listed on Univs Agencies by name, office country or city, study destination and language. Returns public profile details (offices by city, destinations, languages, services, reviews) and the profile URL where students contact the agency. Neutral

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries covered by the Univs.com catalogue with their slugs, institute counts and page URLs.
